Brandon Ingram scored the Raptors' first basket more than anyone in 2025-26: 22 times in 82 starts, or 27% of the games they started. Scottie Barnes was next with 15. The Raptors made the game's first field goal in 55% of their 89 games and won 43% of their opening tipoffs. Everything below is counted from the play-by-play of every 2025-26 game (1,225 regular season, 85 playoffs, 6 play-in).
